newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Golf-Argentine Gonzalez wins Nigerian Open.
newsitem.headline: Golf-Argentine Gonzalez wins Nigerian Open.

text.p: Roberto Gonzalez, a 27-year-old Argentine professional beat Joe Higgins of Britain to win the annual Nigerian Open in the capital Abuja on Sunday.
Gonzalez won $41,660 in prize money while Higgins got $27,000 and another Argentine, Jorge Berendt, who came third received $15,760.
The best Nigerian, Lucky Suleiman, shared the 15th position with eight others including Zimbabwean Slean Farrel.
Gonzalez was elated at winning. "This has compensated me for the suffering I encountered which included a fever at the weekend," he told reporters.
